thread:
maria (partnerships): Hey team — Voltedge asked about a joint perf/W + throughput sweep on their new 'HelixS' board. Can we sketch the scope and who's owning what?
aj (perf): +1. Need clear workloads, target sequences, and kernel knobs. My initial ask: 1) transformer-3B / 4k seq, 2) chat-like bursty load (p95 latency), 3) batched throughput steady-state. Metrics: tokens/s, Watt (wall), p50/p95 latency, memory headroom.
sunil (voltedge): We can provision 6 HelixS units next week. We also have thermal logs and per-core power sensors. Want to include weighted power (idle-subtracted) and chip-temp delta.
elaine (solutions): Marketing will want a joint one-pager + embargo dates if this leads to a case study. Can we target a draft by EOD Thurs?
maria (partnerships): Timeline makes sense. Aj — can you post a minimal runbook we can hand to Voltedge? Include scripts, expected artifacts, and acceptance criteria.
aj (perf): Will do. Draft checklist: 
- bench repo: git.redwood/benchmarks/helixs-sweep
- workloads: small-transformer (3B), medium-rewrite (7B-lite) emulated chat
- run modes: single-stream, 8x-batch (bs=8), 16x-batch
- telemetry: perf counters + ipmitool power + vendor sensors
- kernel flags: sched_tick_granularity=1, bigcpu governor=ondemand, l2_prefetch toggle (on/off)
- quant: int8 vs fp16 baseline
- acceptance: >95% run completion, consistent power sample window (30s), no OOMs
I'll drop a minimal script snippet below.
aj (perf): ```bash
# example runner snippet
python run_bench.py --model small-transformer --seq 4096 --mode single --samples 100 
--telemetry sensors,ipmi,perf --out ./results/helixs_single.json
```
todd (lab-ops): Heads-up — Rack B is booked Wed morning for firmware updates. I can reserve Wed afternoon and Thu for the sweep. Need ~4 hours per config.
sunil (voltedge): We'll bring our kernel patch branch and access to on-die sensors. Can we agree on ciphered artifact exchange? We prefer s3 presigned links + GPG signature.
elaine (solutions): Agreed on presigned links. For the case study embargo, can we set a tentative date two weeks after the lab run for internal sign-off? Marketing to sign off copy.
maria (partnerships): Sounds good. Action items: Aj to publish runbook and baseline scripts; Sunil to share kernel branch + sensors access; Todd to reserve Rack B; Elaine to prepare embargo timeline and template.
aj (perf): Published initial runbook draft: git.redwood/benchmarks/helixs-sweep/blob/draft-0. See section 'telemetry-ops' for the sampling cadence. Note: prefer 1s power sampling, 10s window aggregates.
benchbot: CI: small-transformer smoke on HelixS passed — 30 iters, avg tokens/s=12.3, avg power=145W. Logs: https://ci.redwood/helixs/5198765432-smoke
sunil (voltedge): Great. I'll upload sensor schema and psuedo-example payloads to the shared S3 by EOD.
aj (perf): One more ask — can Voltedge enable persistent perf counters (llc-misses, cycles)? Those help correlate perf/W.
sunil (voltedge): Yes, will enable.
elaine (solutions): I'll slot a quick sync with Marketing Friday 09:30 PT to review embargo template. Anyone else want to join?
maria (partnerships): I'll be there. Aj?
aj (perf): Yup.
todd (lab-ops): Booked — Rack B reserved Thu 13:00-18:00.
maria (partnerships): Perfect. Closing loop: Next check-in Friday post-marketing sync. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
